title: CoSyDelay: Cognitive Symbolic Regression for Traffic Delay Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19946v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Trustworthy estimation of traffic delays at signalized intersections is critical for modern transportation systems, as it supports proactive traffic control for congestion mitigation. Existing analytical methods often rely on idealized assumptions that limit their accuracy under complex traffic conditions, whereas data-driven methods may achieve strong estimation performance but usually lack transparent structures, which reduces confidence in their practical application. To address these limitations, we propose CoSyDelay, a cognitive symbolic regression (SR) framework for automatically deriving explicit and physically consistent empirical delay estimation expressions (DEEs). Specifically, CoSyDelay decomposes intersection-level delay estimation into turning-movement-level subproblems, thereby reducing the complexity of the symbolic search. During DEE learning, CoSyDelay constructs domain-informed symbolic inputs from traffic variables.

translated_title: CoSyDelay：用于交通延误估计的认知符号回归
translated_abstract: 对信号交叉口交通延误的可信估计对现代交通系统至关重要，因为它支持以缓解拥堵为目标的主动式交通控制。现有的解析方法通常依赖于理想化假设，限制了其在复杂交通条件下的精度；而数据驱动方法虽然可能实现较强的估计性能，但通常缺乏透明的结构，降低了其应用于实际的可信度。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了CoSyDelay，一个认知符号回归（SR）框架，用于自动推导显式且物理一致的经验延误估计表达式（DEEs）。具体而言，CoSyDelay将交叉口层面的延误估计分解为转向流向层面的子问题，从而降低了符号搜索的复杂度。在DEE学习过程中，CoSyDelay基于交通变量构建领域知识驱动的符号输入。
tldr: 提出认知符号回归框架CoSyDelay，通过将交叉口延误估计分解为转向流向层面的子问题，自动推导出显式且物理一致的经验延误估计表达式。
en_tdlr: CoSyDelay, a cognitive symbolic regression framework, automatically derives explicit and physically consistent delay estimation expressions by decomposing intersection-level delay estimation into turning-movement-level subproblems.
